name: 993 Turbo catalytic converter pair, left and right (PicoGK concept)
material_candidate: IN625 LPBF (concept assumption; the record leaves the material unknown)
picogk_enhancement: Concept base model of the two converter cans: one smooth revolved flow volume per converter (pipe, diffuser, can with rolled-in beads, nozzle, pipe) swept along a centreline that S-bends outboard in the inlet, with a uniform wall offset from it, a spherical ball-joint collar, a lobed outlet flange and an oxygen-sensor boss, filleted as one body. The can diameter fills the Cargraphic aftermarket Ø110 mm declaration; every other dimension and all interfaces are assumptions. The substrate, mat and heat shield (pos 19 cover) are not modelled: each can is hollow and open at both ends, so the model says nothing about conversion, back-pressure or durability. The two ties only hold the pair together for display.

body_diameter_mm.note: Cargraphic Powerkit 2 for the 993 Turbo lists '100 cpsi catalytic converters Ø110 mm' (catalog/reference/993-turbo-research-20261002/turbo-evidence.json, TURBO-CARGRAPHIC-993-K16-24; SRC-CARGRAPHIC-993-K16-24-POWERKIT-DATA). An aftermarket sport converter, not the OEM 993 113 213 57 / 214 57; reading Ø110 as the can outer diameter is the concept interpretation

body_length_mm.note: can length between the cones; substrate volume unknown

pipe_outer_diameter_mm.note: inlet and outlet pipe OD; TurbineOutletStubDiaMm = 60 in parts/m64-exhaust-0001/source/picogk/Program.cs (ASSUMED there too)

wall_mm.note: uniform wall of the can and pipes (2.0 mm keeps about three voxels at the 0.6 mm study voxel)

inlet_pipe_length_mm.note: inlet pipe length before the diffuser, with the outboard S-bend

inlet_offset_y_mm.note: outboard offset of the inlet pipe (S-bend); routing unknown

outlet_pipe_length_mm.note: outlet pipe length after the nozzle

bead_count.note: rolled-in stiffening beads on the can

bead_depth_mm.note: bead depth (inward, so the can keeps its diameter)

ball_collar_radius_mm.note: spherical ball-joint collar on the inlet pipe; the manual names ball clamps (25-30 Nm) but no ball geometry

ball_collar_x_mm.note: collar position from the inlet face

outlet_flange_radius_mm.note: outlet flange radius (inside the can diameter)

outlet_bolt_offset_mm.note: outlet bolt centres at +/-46 mm across the pipe

o2_boss_radius_mm.note: oxygen-sensor boss radius; the PET lists O2 sensors 993 606 128 01 / 127 01 in the same assembly, their position is not known

o2_boss_length_mm.note: boss height beyond the cone wall

pair_spacing_mm.note: display spacing between the two can axes; not the car's layout

tie_radius_mm.note: display tie radius; the ties hold the pair as one body and are not part of either converter

fillet_mm.note: outer blend of collar, boss, flange and ties

open_interfaces: heat-exchanger / turbine-side inlet joint and ball-clamp geometry
rear muffler / tail pipe outlet flange
substrate, mat, can and heat-shield (pos 19) geometry
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
